mappings.product_miss: The shared truth/eval layer already contained unemployment-insurance knowledge and synthetic a-kassa cases, but the public shell still treated an explicit current job loss as a broad work journey and could delay the first-day action behind generic questions.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the existing transparent work router and shared person surface. For explicit current unemployment only, add a first-day guidance layer that points first to Arbetsförmedlingen registration and then to the unemployment fund, with a coarse private_person + unemployment_start handoff. Future job loss, permittering and sickness intents must stay on their existing routes.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Current Arbetsförmedlingen guidance supports registration on the first unemployed day and subsequent unemployment-fund application. Försäkringskassan owns individual SGI assessment. Neither registration nor this route proves eligibility, benefit amount, SGI outcome or which historical/current unemployment-insurance rule applies to the individual.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: Keep raw situation text, employer, exact employment dates, income, unemployment-fund membership and identity out of URL and structured feedback. The handoff may contain only actor_type=private_person, focus=unemployment_start and language.
